summary: Trekor Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing it will release second quarter 2026 financial results after market close on August 5, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast on August 6, 2026. No strategic transaction, special event, or material corporate action is described. The filing is a routine earnings announcement notice, which does not constitute a special situation. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under Form 6-K, and the disclosure is administrative in nature. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural notes to evaluate.
